main_text.p: eryftallina hinc inde pofita, liquores diverfimode coloratos, & vinorum diverfi generis ideas referentes: fi enim praedictis tinkturis (leviter ita ut aftantium oculos omnino effugiant,) medicata immiffae aquae nonlolum vina quaelibet imitari instituent; fed ipfum Poetarum Protea in undas mutatum, & colores omnes formafque infinitas induentem, exhibebunt. Et porro, Hujufmodi phaenomenon ratio fi inquiratur, inquit, omnino peti debet a particulis minutis, intra poros cujuflibet liquoris contentis; quae quoad fitum & pofitionem, ab alio liquore diverfimode alteratae, radios lucis diverfimode tranfmittunt, multifariam refringunt autreflectunt, adeoque diverfas colorum apparentias faciunt. Cum enim radii lucis fere recta pertranfeunt, fit {*}color inftar aquae fontanae limpidae, fi in tranfitu parum refringantur, liquor citrinefcit: plus adhuc refracti, ruborem inducunt: fi incurventur adeo ut non denuo

page.notes: Marginal marks are only small star/asterisk signs; the word "Sympathetico" is the running head. Some words in the text are uncertain given the scan's low contrast in the upper text, and the spellings "tinkturis", "Hujufmodi" were read from the scan with some doubt. The page ends mid-sentence, continuing on the next page. The bottom catchword "denuo" is printed at foot right as a catchword and the text is not repeated there.
